name: UKG Pro
description: Let agents read employees, jobs, supervisors and your organization in UKG Pro, and, only if you allow it, time off balances and pay. For joiner and leaver checks, HR change requests, benefits and leave cases, merit files and payroll audits. Agents change nothing.
identity: A UKG Pro web service account, with View on only the web services you grant it, and your company's customer API key.

setup.title: Create a web service account
setup.body: Create the account as a UKG Pro system administrator. UKG Pro generates its password and shows it once.
click: In UKG Pro, open System Configuration > Security > Service Account Administration > Add.
User name: ai-agents. Copy the password UKG Pro shows.

setup.title: Grant View on the web services agents read
setup.body: Give the account the View role on the web services below, and nothing else: pay and time off are listed only if you allow them. Without a service UKG Pro refuses those calls.
click: On the account, grant View for each web service below and save.

setup.title: Find your service address and customer API key
setup.body: The service address differs by data center and between production and test, such as service5.ultipro.com or service4.ultipro.ca. It is not the address you sign in at. You can test everything with the command below: it lists your companies and changes nothing.
click: Open System Configuration > Security > Web Services.
Copy the host name of the service endpoint, without https:// and /services, and the Customer API Key.

fields.label: Service address
fields.help: The host name of your web services endpoint, such as service5.ultipro.com.

capabilities.label: Read employees and organization
capabilities.description: List and read employment details (job, status, supervisor, hire and termination dates), names and work emails, supervisors, and your companies, jobs and org levels.
capabilities.note: Read-only. Home addresses, national IDs, health and other personal details are left out of the answers. Reaches every company unless you keep a key to chosen companies.

capabilities.label: Read time off balances
capabilities.description: Read employees' time off plans with hours earned, taken and pending.

capabilities.label: Read pay and compensation
capabilities.description: Read employees' pay rates, annual salary, pay group, salary grade and review dates, and their job history with each rate change and promotion.
capabilities.note: Pay is sensitive: give it only to agents that prepare merit files or payroll audits. Read-only.

limits.label: Companies
limits.help: Optional: only employees of these companies, by company ID, shown under Companies after connecting. Agents must then name the company in each call. Leave empty for every company.

revoke: In UKG Pro, open System Configuration > Security > Service Account Administration and delete the ai-agents account. Agents lose access to UKG Pro at once.

tools.name: ukg_list_employment_details
tools.description: List employees' employment details. A date filter takes a date as 01-01-2026, >01-01-2026 (after), <01-01-2026 (before) or {01-01-2026,03-01-2026} (between). Answers one page; ask for the next page while a page comes back full.

company_id.description: Only employees of this company ID

supervisor_employee_id.description: Only the reports of this supervisor's employee ID

Answers one page; ask for the next page while a page comes back full.

tools.description: Read one employee's time off plans with hours earned, taken and pending.
